title: It’s NOT Trash...It’ Environmental
text: It’s NOT Trash...It’ Environmental. The batteries wear out very quickly. There is a major design flaw, if you choose to go manual there are no handles or grips to use, you have to be creative and rig something up with velcro.There should be an easy way to turn off the infrared search light at night. The On/Off switches are not that convenient, nor are the battery trays. I’m sure it would be too expensive but these are my recommendations: 1) place handles that one can easily grab when batteries are dead or one chooses to go manual;  2) put a 12 hour timer on so you save battery power and if you are near the can you won’t be disturbed by the flashing light; and 3) say which bags are the right size and color for different recyclables and for the different sized cans you make.

description: This 13 Gal Recycling stainless steel Touch Free Motion Sensor Oval Trash Can is designed and engineered by NINESTARS, the world's first legal patent holder. With its sleek oval fingerprint-resistant design, it can be used in almost any place, such as the kitchen, office break room, cafeteria, restuarant and other possible recycling areas. This durable trash can uses the most advanced sensor technology which can be found in all Ninestars trash cans. Pass your hand or debris within ten inches or a 130° angle from the infrared sensor and the lid will automatically open. The lid will remain open if debris or hand remains within the range of the infrared sensor. Three seconds after your hand moves away from the lid, it will close automatically. Power lasts up to 6 months in normal daily usage. It includes a garbage bag ring to keep trash bag from public view for a neat and clean appearance. Non-skid base protects your flooring from scuff marks
